meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Viet Nam (national single-jurisdiction; enterprise registration administered through provincial Departments of Planning and Investment under uniform national law)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (socialist-oriented civil law system; codified statutes are the primary source; no formal binding judicial precedent, though higher-court rulings carry persuasive weight)

Agreement Between Japan and the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam for the Liberalization, Promotion and Protection of Investment (2003, as updated)

Treaty Between the Federal Republic of Germany and the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam Concerning the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investments (1993, active)
ASEAN Comprehensive Investment Agreement (ACIA, in force for Viet Nam 2012)
Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP, in force for Viet Nam on 14 January 2019)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 06/2022/QH15 (adopted 15 November 2022; effective 1 March 2023), implemented by Decree No. 14/2023/ND-CP (17 April 2023; effective 1 June 2023) and State Bank of Viet Nam Circular No. 27/2023/TT-NHNN; Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration (beneficial-owner identification and enterprise-register filing); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14; Law on Credit Institutions No. 47/2010/QH12 as amended; Decree No. 101/2012/ND-CP as amended by Decree No. 80/2016/ND-CP (non-cash payment regime for licensing of remittance/payment-intermediary services); Decree No. 111/2011/ND-CP on consular legalization.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (shareholders and capital-contribution percentages of the LLC are filed with the provincial Department of Planning and Investment and held in the National Business Registration Portal; AML beneficial-ownership declarations are collected internally by the reporting institution and are disclosable to the State Bank of Viet Nam, the Financial Intelligence Unit and competent prosecution authorities; no public UBO register exists; nominee arrangements are not recognized for AML/CFT purposes)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the corporate registration/incorporation certificate of each foreign corporate shareholder and its current legal representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the shareholder's home jurisdiction (e.g., ACRA in Singapore, ASIC in Australia, SAMR in the People's Republic of China)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if the home state is an Apostille Convention Contracting State) OR Consular Legalization at the Embassy/Consulate of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam in the home state (if a non-Convention state)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and proof-of-address records of each proposed beneficial owner, General Director and AML compliance officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or civil registry authority in the territory of document origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the origin state plus Hague Apostille; if the origin state is not an Apostille Convention Contracting State, consular legalization by the Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate is mandatory prior to Vietnamese use

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Judicial record certificate (police clearance) of the proposed General Director and each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or judicial-records authority of the person's country of residence (e.g., provincial police clearance in the PRC, criminal history check in Australia or Singapore)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR consular legalization of the state-issued original, followed by recognized Vietnamese notarial acceptance of the certificate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Vietnamese translation (certified translation) of the legalized corporate, identity and judicial-record documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Duly registered certified translation office in Viet Nam, followed by Vietnamese notarization
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Vietnamese notarization; the underlying foreign documents must already bear the apostille or consular legalization, otherwise the Department of Planning and Investment and the State Bank of Viet Nam will not accept the translation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, particularly Articles 27-29 on enterprise registration, Articles 46-56 on multi-member limited liability companies, and Articles 73-75 on single-member limited liability companies; Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 37-39 on the Investment Registration Certificate; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration and investment procedures; Law on Credit Institutions No. 47/2010/QH13 as amended; Decree No. 80/2016/ND-CP on payment intermediary services; Decree No. 70/2014/ND-CP on cross-border remittance service licensing; Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15; Civil Code No. 91/2015/QH13 relevant to corporate contracts and obligations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office under the provincial Department of Planning and Investment, acting through the National Enterprise Registration Portal for the Certificate of Enterprise Registration; the provincial Investment Registration Agency for the Investment Registration Certificate; the State Bank of Vietnam as the special competent licensing authority for cross-border remittance and payment intermediary services.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration filed electronically via the National Enterprise Registration Portal; Application for Investment Registration Certificate submitted to the provincial Investment Registration Agency; Payment Intermediary Service License Application and Cross-Border Remittance Service License Application submitted to the State Bank of Vietnam.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: There is no statutory minimum charter capital for an ordinary limited liability company under the Law on Enterprises 2020. However, for the licensed cross-border remittance activity, Decree No. 70/2014/ND-CP requires a minimum licensed chartered capital of VND 1,000 billion for cross-border remittance service providers, and Decree No. 80/2016/ND-CP requires a minimum legal capital of VND 50 billion for payment intermediary service providers. Charter capital must be fully paid within 90 days after issuance of the Certificate of Enterprise Registration, with funds held in a blocked capital contribution account at a licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam and verified by an independent audit before SBV licensing.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY, VIET NAM

RESOLVED unanimously by the founding members holding 100% of the charter capital of [COMPANY NAME] Limited Liability Company, in writing, pursuant to Articles 27, 46, 47 and related governance provisions of the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, as follows:

1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION AND CONTRIBUTION: The Company approves its charter capital of VND [•] as stated in the Investment Registration Certificate. Each founding member subscribes to the charter capital stated in the Company Charter, agrees to contribute the full subscribed amount within 90 days of issuance of the Certificate of Enterprise Registration, and authorizes the Legal Representative to open a blocked capital contribution account at a licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam for such purpose.

2. REGISTERED OFFICE: The registered office of the Company is hereby adopted at [full address, province/city, Viet Nam]. The Legal Representative is authorized to file the enterprise registration dossier, publish company details on the National Enterprise Registration Portal, and notify the Department of Planning and Investment and the General Department of Taxation of any future change of the registered office.

3. OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: The Company hereby appoints [Name] as Legal Representative and Chairman/President, with full authority to represent the Company before all state organs, courts, and third parties; [Name] as General Director/Chief Executive Officer, responsible for daily corporate governance and business operations; [Name] as Chief Accountant, responsible for statutory accounting and tax compliance; and [Name] as Anti-Money Laundering Compliance Officer, responsible for AML/KYC policies and SBV reporting.

4. CHARTER AND GOVERNANCE: The Company Charter submitted to the Business Registration Office is adopted in full. The internal governance bylaws, AML/KYC manual, financial reporting calendar, and internal audit policy are approved as binding corporate documents.

5. POST-INCORPORATION AUTHORIZATIONS: The Legal Representative and General Director are jointly authorized to open corporate bank accounts, apply to the State Bank of Vietnam for the payment intermediary license and cross-border remittance license, negotiate SWIFT connectivity and local cash-pickup clearing agreements, execute office leases, procure fire safety and environmental clearances, and take all actions necessary to commence lawful operations.

ADOPTED in writing on [date] at [place], Viet Nam, by unanimous consent of all founding members. This Resolution is effective immediately and remains in force until amended or revoked by a duly adopted subsequent resolution.

Signed by all founding members: [Founder 1], [Founder 2], and [Founder 3], collectively representing 100% of the charter capital.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Name Clearance and Pre-Investment Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Enterprise Registration Portal; Investment Registration Agency under the provincial Department of Planning and Investment; State Bank of Vietnam for pre-consultation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an online name reservation application proposing a lawful Vietnamese company name comprising a name element and a business type element. Simultaneously screen the intended activity of cross-border money transmission against the WTO Services Commitments and Decree 31/2021/ND-CP to confirm conditional market access. Request a preliminary written or meeting-based consultation from the State Bank of Vietnam on the minimum licensed capital, technical infrastructure, and AML systems required for a cross-border remittance and payment intermediary license.
required_dossiers: Online name reservation application
Constitutional and identification documents of all founding members
Draft Company Charter
Power of attorney for the filing agent
Business plan for cross-border remittance services covering SWIFT and local cash-pickup clearing rails
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name conflicts with an existing enterprise name, the portal issues a refusal notice. The applicant must re-submit with up to two alternative names within five working days, free of charge. If the sector screening indicates a conditional activity, the applicant must obtain the preliminary SBV opinion before proceeding.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Investment Registration Certificate Application for Foreign-Invested LLC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Registration Agency, provincial Department of Planning and Investment; Ministry of Planning and Investment for projects subject to higher-level approval.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and submit the Investment Registration Certificate dossier under Articles 37 and 38 of the Law on Investment 2020. The project proposal must identify the ISIC 6619 money transmission business, the target payment rails (SWIFT and local cash-pickup clearing), the charter capital amount, the physical registered office, and the implementation timeline. The Investment Registration Agency will consult the State Bank of Vietnam because the activity is conditional, and will issue or deny the Investment Registration Certificate.
required_dossiers: Application for Investment Registration Certificate in the form prescribed by Decree 31/2021/ND-CP
Certified copies of constitutional documents and identification of each foreign investor
Audited financial statements of investors for the most recent year or equivalent proof of capital capability
Detailed investment project proposal covering remittance operations and payment rails
Office lease commitment or site allocation document
Charter capital contribution schedule with source confirmation
Written preliminary consultative opinion of the State Bank of Vietnam on licensing feasibility
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is incomplete or inconsistent, the Investment Registration Agency issues a written request for amendment within 10 working days. The applicant cures the deficiencies and re-submits, and the statutory review period recomputes. An unjustified denial may be appealed to the provincial People's Committee or challenged under administrative complaint procedures of Decree 122/2021/ND-CP.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Registration and Issuance of the Certificate of Enterprise Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment via the National Enterprise Registration Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following the grant of the Investment Registration Certificate, submit the enterprise registration dossier through the National Enterprise Registration Portal. The electronic system will integrate the enterprise code and tax identification number. Review the Company Charter, the legal representative appointment, the subscribed charter capital, and the registered office. No official filing fee is charged for online enterprise registration in Viet Nam. Upon approval, the Certificate of Enterprise Registration is issued, establishing the LLC as a legal entity.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration
Company Charter approved by all founding members
Certified list of founding members and the legal representative
Certified copy of the Investment Registration Certificate
Identification documents of members and appointed officers
Statement of capital contribution commitment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Business Registration Office queries the dossier, the applicant receives an electronic notice stating the grounds. The applicant corrects and resubmits within the cure period. Repeated rejection may be addressed through an amended filing or an administrative complaint under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance, Tax, Social Insurance and Bank Account Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Department of Taxation and provincial Tax Department; Vietnam Social Security; National Enterprise Registration Portal; licensed commercial banks in Viet Nam.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of the Certificate of Enterprise Registration, publish enterprise particulars on the National Enterprise Registration Portal. Open a direct operational bank account and a blocked capital contribution account at a licensed commercial bank. Register for corporate income tax, value-added tax, and electronic tax filing with the tax authority. Register the entity and its employees with Vietnam Social Security. Adopt the first board resolution, seal specimen declaration, and internal governance documents.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Enterprise Registration
Company Charter
Identification documents of the legal representative and officers
Seal specimen declaration
Corporate bank account opening application
Tax registration declaration form
Employee registration list for social insurance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correction of erroneous public records is performed by filing an amended enterprise registration application with the Department of Planning and Investment. Tax code issuance delays are cured by direct escalation to the local tax office or GDT helpdesk. Bank account approval disputes are resolved through submission of additional due diligence documents under prevailing bank internal policies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: State Bank of Vietnam Licensing for Cross-Border Remittance and Payment Intermediary Services
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Bank of Vietnam, Department of Payment Systems, and the Banking Supervision Agency.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the consolidated licensing application to the State Bank of Vietnam under Decree No. 80/2016/ND-CP for payment intermediary services and Decree No. 70/2014/ND-CP for cross-border remittance services. Demonstrate full contribution of the statutory minimum licensed capital, deploy compliant AML/KYC systems under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering 2022, execute SWIFT connectivity agreements, conclude local cash-pickup clearing arrangements with Vietnamese commercial banks, and document information security standards under Decree 13/2023/ND-CP. The State Bank of Vietnam will conduct an on-site inspection of the registered office, technical systems, and internal control environment before issuance.
required_dossiers: License application form to the State Bank of Vietnam
Certificate of Enterprise Registration and Investment Registration Certificate
Company Charter and governance manual
AML/KYC compliance manual approved by the compliance officer
Audited financial statements and bank confirmation of paid-up licensed capital
SWIFT membership or connectivity agreement
Local cash-pickup clearing and agent network agreements
Business plan with remittance risk controls and liquidity projections
Information security and data center technical documentation
Internal audit and outsourcing governance policy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The State Bank of Vietnam may issue a written request for additional documentation or an on-site inspection deficiency memorandum. The applicant must cure all gaps within the specified period. A denial based on capital, AML systems, or technical infrastructure defects may be cured and the application re-filed; a formal refusal may be appealed under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial Fire Safety, Occupational, and Environmental Licensing for Physical Operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Fire Protection and Rescue Police under the Ministry of Public Security; provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment; construction inspection authorities under the Ministry of Construction.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain fire safety appraisal and acceptance certification for the office premises and any IT operations center used for remittance processing. File an environmental registration dossier or confirm exemption for the service-sector operation under the Law on Environmental Protection 2020. Verify the structural load and building-use compliance of the registered office through a licensed construction inspection entity. Complete occupational health and safety clearance under the Law on Occupational Safety 2015, including employee workplace risk assessment and fire drills. Secure the physical records and data-center clearance required by SBV Circular No. 09/2020/TT-NHNN on information security.
required_dossiers: Fire safety design approval and acceptance certificate
Environmental registration form or exemption confirmation
Office lease agreement and floor plans
Structural certification from a licensed engineer
Occupational health and safety risk assessment
Emergency response and workplace safety plan
Physical security policy and data-center access documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If inspection identifies non-compliance, the company rectifies the fire suppression systems, emergency lighting, structural reinforcement, or ventilation as specified in the inspection report and re-applies for inspection. Environmental registration queries are cured by amending the submitted information and resubmitting to the provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: State Bank of Vietnam as the primary financial licensing authority; Ministry of Public Security for cybersecurity and data-center supervision; Ministry of Information and Communications for cross-border data transmission and network safety; Ministry of Industry and Trade only insofar as general commercial registration conditions apply.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: License to Provide Payment Intermediary Services and License to Provide Cross-Border Remittance Services, both issued by the State Bank of Vietnam; registration of payment systems and settlement activity under the Law on Credit Institutions.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment and the provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration under Group III of the environmental registration regime or exemption: the cross-border remittance service is a non-manufacturing office-based service with no industrial processing, no significant wastewater discharge, and no atmospheric emissions, therefore a full Environmental Impact Assessment report is not required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Sanitary wastewater from office premises connected to the municipal sewer system must conform to QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT for domestic wastewater; standby diesel generators, if any, must comply with QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT for industrial emissions; there is no VOC process emission source from the money transmission activity; waste electronic media and paper records must be handled under Decree 40/2019/ND-CP on waste management, with hazardous components pre-treated by a licensed waste treatment facility.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certification issued by the Fire Protection and Rescue Police for the registered office and data-processing premises; civil defense coordination approval confirming the building siting, means of escape, automatic fire suppression, and emergency access routes; structural load clearance from a licensed inspection entity confirming floor loading capacity for IT racks and safes; workplace safety and occupational health clearance under the Law on Occupational Safety 2015 including annual health checks for employees and safety training records; physical security and access-control clearance under SBV Circular No. 09/2020/TT-NHNN to protect customer data, cash-handling areas, and payment system infrastructure.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation of Viet Nam (Tổng cục Thuế), an agency of the Ministry of Finance; primary electronic portal: https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn; e-invoice clearance portal: https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn; National Business Registration Portal: https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Viet Nam uses a single Tax Identification Number (Mã số thuế, MST) for all taxes, including corporate income tax (CIT), VAT, fringe benefit/PIT withholding and license fees. For a foreign-invested limited liability company, procurement is automatic: (1) the Ministry of Planning and Investment's provincial Department of Planning and Investment issues the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC); (2) the DPI synchronizes the incorporation record with the General Department of Taxation through the National Business Registration Information System, and the tax authority issues the 13-digit MST for the LLC without a separate application; (3) within the statutory calibration period the LLC must complete supplementary tax registration through the Electronic Tax Portal using Form 01-ĐK-TCT (Circular No. 105/2020/TT-BTC), designating the competent local/sub-tax office, legal representative, branches, bank accounts and the accounting regime; (4) the LLC must register its electronic invoice scheme and obtain the digital signature (chữ ký số) before issuing e-invoices. Non-resident foreign entities without a PE in Viet Nam that supply services to the LLC do not need an MST: the Vietnamese payer must register, declare and withhold Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT, comprising CIT and VAT) on each payment and remit it through the payer's own MST under Decree No. 126/2020/ND-CP. The reverse direction is equally relevant: when the LLC receives fee income from foreign remittance partners for payout/cash pick-up services performed in Viet Nam, that income is taxable in Viet Nam in the LLC's own MST because the LLC is a domestic resident enterprise; no FCT applies to that inward stream.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the LLC is a Vietnamese resident corporate taxpayer taxed at entity level on worldwide income under corporate income tax at a standard headline rate of 20%; there is no pass-through/fiscally transparent status for a Vietnamese LLC, and foreign shareholders are not taxed by reference to the LLC's income until repatriation events. Territorial scope: residents are taxed on worldwide income; non-residents are taxed only on Viet Nam-source income. Tax-exempt-zone/special investment regimes (e.g., export processing enterprises, high-tech parks, special economic zones) are available only upon separate certification and licensing; a licensed remittance LLC operating cross-border payment rails will ordinarily remain outside such preferential zones and is classified as an ordinary taxable resident enterprise.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam does not have a US-style 'check-the-box' election, and its anti-hybrid rules (contained in Decree No. 132/2020/ND-CP on transfer pricing and controlled transactions) provide no elective hybrid-mismatch regime. The elections lawfully available to the LLC are: (i) VAT calculation method: the deduction/credit method is compulsory for taxpayers with annual turnover of VND 1 billion or more; smaller taxpayers may elect between the direct method and the deduction method; (ii) fiscal year: election of any 12-month accounting year differing from the calendar year, provided the tax declarations and financial statements align to that elected year and the tax administration is notified; (iii) investment-based CIT incentive elections: eligible new investment projects (high-technology, supporting industry, industrial park/economic zone projects) may elect the preferential CIT rate and tax holiday regime under the Law on CIT and implementing regulations, with the incentive registered/harmonized through the annual tax settlement; (iv) FCT settlement: a foreign contractor may elect to be placed on the 'declaration, assessment and payment' track rather than pure withholding only if it maintains a PE and a VAT-deduction status in Viet Nam; a remittance LLC as payer should document the non-resident status of each offshore counterparty accordingly. No consolidated group or fiscal unity election exists in Viet Nam; each licensed legal entity files standalone CIT and VAT returns.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV / Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam), acting through its Foreign Exchange Management Department and Banking Supervision Agency; complementary authority over foreign direct investment licensing and trade-linked foreign exchange resides with the Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI) and the General Department of Vietnam Customs.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Viet Nam accepted IMF Article VIII obligations in 2017, underpinning current-account convertibility for trade, services and income, yet the VND remains managed and the capital account is administered. Inward direct investment, shareholder loans, intercompany liquidity and profit repatriation are permitted only through a Foreign Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) opened at an SBV-licensed bank and registered with the SBV; remittance-service fees from non-resident senders qualify as current-account service receipts settleable through standard banking channels. Profit remittance requires (i) audited annual financial statements, (ii) Corporate Income Tax finalization, (iii) updated Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC), and (iv) DICA registration, and must be executed within the permitted annual cycle; documentary delays, tax-clearance prerequisites and administrative discretion create residual repatriation hurdles, but no systemic convertibility embargo exists for lawful current-account flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For resident exporters, Decree 70/2014/ND-CP and Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN impose a statutory duty to credit export proceeds to a foreign-currency account at an authorized bank and to surrender 80 percent of export receipts to a licensed credit institution within 30 calendar days of receipt; 100 percent foreign-invested export processing enterprises and entities granted SBV exemption rulings are outside this mandatory surrender ratio. This VN_LLC money-transmission company operates a service-receipts model rather than an exporter, so the 80 percent surrender rule does not govern its inbound remittance floats; however, any ancillary foreign-currency receipts must either be converted to VND through authorized banks or held in an approved foreign-currency account, and the company must make timely inward lodging to avoid deemed-noncompliance penalties.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low direct feasibility. An offshore digital EMI cannot hold VND clearing accounts, issue payment instruments or operate a payout network in Viet Nam without an SBV-issued intermediary payment service license under Decree 101/2012/ND-CP (as amended by Decree 80/2016/ND-CP), which requires a locally incorporated entity, a statutory minimum charter capital (approximately VND 50 billion for intermediary payment services), proven technical infrastructure, board and UBO fitness, and a demonstrated AML/CFT program; such licenses are rarely granted absent a strategic local banking partner. The viable architecture is a partnership or agency model: the offshore EMI originates remittance instructions and settlement outside Viet Nam, while a licensed Viet Nam credit institution or licensed payment intermediary performs VND payout, cash-pickup clearing and domestic compliance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical presence. Vietnamese banks uniformly require the physical appearance of the legal representative, or a Vietnamese-resident authorized representative holding a notarized power of attorney, at the account-opening branch, with passport and original IRC/ERC verification; fully remote corporate onboarding is not accepted for an FDI high-risk money-transmission entity. Foreign directors must still undergo in-person identity verification at least once during the relationship, and the account-opening file must include biometric and photographic identity capture under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering (Law No. 14/2022/QH15), Decree 116/2023/ND-CP and SBV KYC guidance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk money services business classification (remittance and payment intermediary sector under FATF-style risk assessment)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SBV payment-intermediary license or binding white-label agency agreement with a licensed credit institution; board-approved AML/CFT policy; designated compliance officer; calibrated transaction-monitoring software; staff training records; customer risk-rating methodology; internal and external AML audit report; five-year record-retention attestation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque offshore shareholding chain and incomplete UBO disclosure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized corporate-structure chart to each natural-person beneficial owner (25 percent control threshold under Law No. 14/2022/QH15); registries and good-standing certificates for every chain entity; passports of all directors and UBOs; share register; source-of-wealth declaration; auditor confirmation of beneficial ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverifiable source and route of initial charter-capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SBV-registered DICA; inward SWIFT MT103 credit memos; IRC/ERC showing charter-capital schedule; shareholder board resolution for capital call; audited financial statements of the sending shareholder; tax identification codes; bank-issued certification of no dual-purpose DICA misuse.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP and corridor-risk exposure in expatriate-worker remittance lanes
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated sanctions and PEP screening against UN, Vietnamese, OFAC, UK and EU lists; contractual indemnity and license evidence from sending money-transmitters; corridor-by-corridor risk assessment; negative media and regulatory checks; specimen regulator letters from source-market licensing agencies.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficiary anonymity in cash-pickup payout and transaction-structuring red flags
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full payer and payee data transmission (name, national ID, address, purpose code) via secure API or structured SWIFT message fields; daily and per-transaction limits; string-detection and structuring-detection rules; beneficiary verification evidence at payout; five-year record retention; agent due-diligence agreements with payout banks.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inward equity and shareholder-loan capital must be wired by SWIFT MT103/202 to the DICA maintained at an SBV-licensed bank, referencing the IRC/ERC number and the inward-direct-investment purpose code under Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN; the bank registers the DICA with the SBV Foreign Exchange Management Department before first utilisation, and each capital draw is reconciled to the charter-capital schedule and subsequent capital-contribution reports to MPI. Remittance operating float from overseas money-transmitters enters a separate operational service-revenue foreign-currency account coded for current-account service receipts; the company then converts to VND at authorized-bank rates and posts VND collateral or prefunding into the payout bank's designated agent-clearing account, with daily reconciliation against beneficiary payout files.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational and trade disbursements use (i) SWIFT MT103 for overseas partner settlement, agent commissions, technology and licensing fees; (ii) Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700/MT707) for documentary trade in corporate treasury operations; and (iii) domestic rails, namely NAPAS ACH and Quick Pay, together with the SBV Interbank Electronic Payment System (IBPS), for VND payouts to beneficiaries, cash-pickup agent prefunding and interbank treasury settlement. Cross-currency disbursements must adhere to the authorized-bank window and retain underlying contracts for the FX-need assessment.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards against VND for genuine current-account exposures, maturing within 365 days, executed with an SBV-licensed credit institution.
FX swaps (VND against USD, EUR and other freely convertible currencies) with a licensed counterparty, tenor within the SBV-authorized maximum, on documented commercial-need substantiation.
Cross-currency swaps for matched mismatches between USD-denominated remittance inflows and VND payout obligations, subject to SBV derivative-framework eligibility.
European-style FX options purchased from an authorized bank for transaction hedging, where permitted by SBV regulations, with no speculative net position.
Onshore NDFs and offshore NDF-indexed hedging are not permissible for residents absent explicit SBV approval; hedging is therefore confined to deliverable onshore instruments.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Operation Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động của doanh nghiệp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) / Business Registration Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the end of the accounting year (by 30 January for calendar-year companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers an administrative fine of VND 5,000,000 – VND 15,000,000 (≈ USD 200 – USD 600) and marks the enterprise as non-compliant; persistent non-reporting can lead to a strike-off notice and eventual deregistration from the national enterprise database.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Annual Financial Statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm đã kiểm toán)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department; Statistical Office; Department of Planning and Investment (for FDI annual compliance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the accounting year-end (by 31 March for calendar-year companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-submission or late submission is subject to administrative fines of up to VND 30,000,000 (≈ USD 1,180); false or unaudited reporting may expose the company to tax reassessment, additional penalties, and refusal of SBV business license renewal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) Finalization Return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department under the General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before 31 March for calendar-year taxpayers (90 days after fiscal year-end; payment due on same date)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment accrues at 0.03% per day; administrative fines for late returns can reach VND 20,000,000 (≈ USD 790); under-declarations carry a penalty of 20% of the additional tax assessed, and enforcement may extend to bank garnishment and license suspension.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Anti-Money Laundering / Remittance Operation Report to the State Bank of Vietnam
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (Banking Supervision Agency; applicable provincial SBV branch)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days after the calendar year-end (by 30 January), in accordance with SBV licensing and AML reporting requirements for licensed remittance agents
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Violations of SBV AML/reporting rules carry administrative fines of up to VND 400,000,000 (≈ USD 15,800) for organizations; serious or repeated failures may result in suspension or revocation of the remittance license and removal from approved payment rails.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All foreign-invested enterprises (including this VN LLC) are subject to mandatory independent audit of annual financial statements regardless of revenue or assets; licensed remittance businesses, credit institutions, insurance enterprises, public companies and parent consolidating enterprises are also mandatorily audited. No turnover-based exemption applies to FDI LLCs.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnam Accounting Standards (VAS) and Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC govern statutory standalone financial statements; IFRS is mandatory for consolidated financial statements of parent entities and permitted for public-interest/listed entities under Ministry of Finance rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam maintains no separate public UBO annual confirmation filing under the Law on Enterprises. For a foreign-invested LLC, member changes and ownership transfers must be recorded in the statutory Member Register and notified to DPI within 7 working days of the change. As a licensed remittance agent, the company must perform AML beneficial-owner due diligence at client onboarding and refresh beneficial-owner records annually or upon risk-triggering events; no annual UBO report to a central UBO registry is required.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Sổ đăng ký thành viên)
Register of Directors and Managers (tracking Members' Council members, legal representatives and daily managers)
Minute Book (Sổ biên bản và nghị quyết of owners'/Members' Council resolutions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 150 – USD 350 per annum for registered-office representation, resident secretary services and corporate agent in Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 – USD 9,500 per annum for the statutory audit of a licensed foreign-invested remittance LLC in Vietnam
